import sys

from jinja2 import Environment, DictLoader, FileSystemLoader, ChoiceLoader, PrefixLoader, FunctionLoader, TemplateNotFound
import tempfile, os

# Basic usage
loader = DictLoader({'template.html': 'Hello {{ name }}!'})
loader.add_alias('main.html', 'template.html')
loader.add_alias('index.html', 'template.html')
env = Environment(loader=loader)
assert env.get_template('template.html').render(name='A') == 'Hello A!'
assert env.get_template('main.html').render(name='B') == 'Hello B!'
assert env.get_template('index.html').render(name='C') == 'Hello C!'

# Removal
loader.remove_alias('main.html')
try:
    env.get_template('main.html'); assert False
except TemplateNotFound as e:
    assert 'main.html' in str(e), e

# remove nonexistent alias is safe
loader.remove_alias('nope.html')

# Broken alias -> error references target
loader.add_alias('broken.html', 'nonexistent.html')
try:
    env.get_template('broken.html'); assert False
except TemplateNotFound as e:
    assert 'nonexistent.html' in str(e) and 'broken.html' not in str(e), e

# Overwrite alias
loader.add_alias('broken.html', 'template.html')
assert env.get_template('broken.html').render(name='D') == 'Hello D!'

# No chaining
l2 = DictLoader({'b.html': 'B', 'c.html': 'C'})
l2.add_alias('a.html', 'b.html')
l2.add_alias('b.html', 'c.html')  # b is now also an alias
env2 = Environment(loader=l2)
assert env2.get_template('a.html').render() == 'B'  # a -> b (content B), not c

# Empty string / special char aliases
l3 = DictLoader({'x': 'XX'})
l3.add_alias('', 'x')
l3.add_alias('we!rd/na$me', 'x')
env3 = Environment(loader=l3)
assert env3.get_template('').render() == 'XX'
assert env3.get_template('we!rd/na$me').render() == 'XX'

# Multiple aliases to same template (already covered)

# FileSystemLoader
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(d, 'real.html'), 'w').write('FS')
fl = FileSystemLoader(d)
fl.add_alias('alias.html', 'real.html')
envf = Environment(loader=fl)
assert envf.get_template('alias.html').render() == 'FS'

# ChoiceLoader
cl = ChoiceLoader([DictLoader({'a.html': 'one'}), DictLoader({'b.html': 'two'})])
cl.add_alias('pick.html', 'b.html')
envc = Environment(loader=cl)
assert envc.get_template('pick.html').render() == 'two'
assert envc.get_template('a.html').render() == 'one'

# PrefixLoader
pl = PrefixLoader({'app1': DictLoader({'index.html': 'P1'})})
pl.add_alias('shortcut', 'app1/index.html')
envp = Environment(loader=pl)
assert envp.get_template('shortcut').render() == 'P1'

# FunctionLoader
fl2 = FunctionLoader(lambda name: 'FN' if name == 'fn.html' else None)

envfn = Environment(loader=fl2)
assert envfn.get_template('fn_alias.html').render() == 'FN'

# Direct get_source resolution
src, fname, uptodate = fl.get_source(None, 'alias.html')
assert src == 'FS'
